description: A powerful visual that brings real SCADA-like capabilities to the Power BI platform. Use the SCADAvis.io Synoptic Editor (available in the Microsoft Store) to create vector graphics and tag data-linked animations directly in the SVG file. Then upload the SVG file to the visual. Available animations include size, rotation, position, color, transparency, text, tooltips, scripts, Vega specifications and more. Free up to 35 animated objects per panel. For more animated objects it is required a corporate annual subscription license. To order a license contact scadavis@dscsys.com. More information here https://scadavis.io/powerbi/.
